_comment: A service set as a log annotation is read back as an unknown value and narrowed before the call: the key/value form through References.CurrentLogAnnotations, the record form by a custom logger through its fiber. Annotation values are unknown in Effect's public types, so a value read back holds no service even after narrowing: both read-back methods and the unread method are removed, and the bundle is not run. Red until the unknown/any rule lands.
